_comment: Single source of truth for the fixed screen layout of the Sprinter render core (port.md section 3.4, 640x256x4bpp mode #82). tools/gen_sprinter_render_layout.py turns this into asm/sprinter/generated/render_layout.inc and render_layout.h so no literal screen coordinate is duplicated by hand in .asm sources. Y bands stack top to bottom and must cover the whole 256-row screen with no gaps; the board and info panel share the MAIN band's row range side by side; the panel's own sub-sections must cover the panel's row range the same way.

bands.name: BANNER
bands.desc: Title/version banner, right-aligned Sprinter logo (hardware-transparent asset).

bands.name: MENU
bands.desc: Menu tab row: FILE DISCONNECT RESET FLIP THEME ABOUT.

bands.name: MOVE
bands.desc: Right (panel column, under the logo): current move + game/turn timers, as on ZX. Left (over the board): the a-h file letters.

bands.name: MAIN
bands.desc: Board (left) and info panel (right), side by side.

bands.name: STATUS
bands.desc: Status bar: connection text left, RTC HH:MM right.

board.desc: 8x8 board, 48x24 px/cell; a-h/1-8 coordinate glyphs render OUTSIDE the playfield as on ZX -- a-h in the MOVE band above it, 1-8 in the margin between the screen edge and x.
